discovery_mentions.text: That guard is called by `composition_parts` at line 1240. Both composition and terminal evaluators route through it: `terminal_parts` calls `composition_parts` at 1302–1304, and the public `r0::Public::terminal_qm31` calls `terminal_parts` at 2044–2063. The relevant circuit/public-digest equations are also built by `public_digest_lanes` (609–694): each old source-index bit chooses an empty-root or old-frontier binding, all levels are included, and the after-root and carry-frontier node are bound separately. `semantic_packed` includes those lanes (1143–1158), and `composition_parts` evaluates `semantic_packed` (1253–1256). Thus the host precheck and the circuit constraints have related level conditions, but they are distinct code paths.

Source path: `r0::Public::terminal_qm31` (pair forest file 2065–2084) calls `terminal_parts` (1285–1310); that calls `composition_parts` (1216–1283) and `equality_value`. The composition path calls `validate_transition` (180–208), `state_only_poseidon::evaluate_state_only_poseidon_oracle_projected` (589 onward), and copy-terminal selector/evaluation code. The generated candidate has transparent structured bodies for these functions. `composition_parts` also has two generated recursive loops.
